name: S3-D7 Combat Droid
description: The S3-D7 Combat Droid was a model of humanoid battle droid used by the Exchange on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The Exchange used a number of S3-D7 droids to patrol the Chemical Refinement District of the Corellian Sector.
